usedFor: Ploomes holds deals, contacts and documents, and Google Drive shares a file by link through “Share File With Anyone”.

bestTemplate.name: “Deal Updated” in Ploomes, then “Share File With Anyone” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: When a deal changes, the action makes a file reachable by link at the access level you pick.

watchOut: “Share File With Anyone” opens a file to anyone with the link, so set Viewer unless people must edit.
